```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(scales)

# Defined ordered factors matching Survey Codes (A1 to A6)
threshold_labels <- c(
  "A1" = "All / almost all (>90%) - Important",
  "A2" = "Most (75-90%) - Important",
  "A3" = "Majority (51-74%) - Important",
  "A4" = "Majority (51-74%) - Unimportant",
  "A5" = "Most (75-90%) - Unimportant",
  "A6" = "All / almost all (>90%) - Unimportant"
)

outcome_names <- c(
  "MID_ARRAY_OUTCOME_A" = "Generic Outcome A",
  "MID_ARRAY_OUTCOME_B" = "Generic Outcome B",
  "MID_ARRAY_OUTCOME_C" = "Generic Outcome C"
)

# Load Survey Export Data : change path/file name accordingly
csv_filepath <- "results.csv"

if (file.exists(csv_filepath)) {
  raw_df <- read_csv(csv_filepath)
} else {
  set.seed(42)
  n <- 100
  raw_df <- tibble(
    id = 1:n,
    MID_ARRAY_OUTCOME_A = sample(names(threshold_labels), n, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.49, 0.21, 0.17, 0.06, 0.06, 0.01)),
    MID_ARRAY_OUTCOME_B = sample(names(threshold_labels), n, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.41, 0.25, 0.16, 0.13, 0.03, 0.02)),
    MID_ARRAY_OUTCOME_C = sample(names(threshold_labels), n, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.55, 0.24, 0.08, 0.08, 0.04, 0.01))
  )
}

# Define ordered threshold levels matching survey options
threshold_levels <- c(
  "All / almost all (>90%) - Important",
  "Most (75-90%) - Important",
  "Majority (51-74%) - Important",
  "Majority (51-74%) - Unimportant",
  "Most (75-90%) - Unimportant",
  "All / almost all (>90%) - Unimportant"
)

# Optional code mapping if exporting answer codes (A1-A6) instead of full text
code_to_text <- c(
  "A1" = "All / almost all (>90%) - Important",
  "A2" = "Most (75-90%) - Important",
  "A3" = "Majority (51-74%) - Important",
  "A4" = "Majority (51-74%) - Unimportant",
  "A5" = "Most (75-90%) - Unimportant",
  "A6" = "All / almost all (>90%) - Unimportant"
)
mycol <- c(
  "All / almost all (>90%) - Unimportant" = "#d62728", # Dark Red
  "Most (75-90%) - Unimportant"           = "#ff7f0e", # Orange
  "Majority (51-74%) - Unimportant"       = "#ffbb78", # Light Orange
  "Majority (51-74%) - Important"         = "#c5b0d5", # Soft Purple
  "Most (75-90%) - Important"             = "#aec7e8", # Light Blue
  "All / almost all (>90%) - Important"   = "#1f77b4"  # Dark Blue
)
# Data processing pipeline
df_processed <- raw_df %>%
  # Select target columns by text pattern or code prefix
  select(contains("generic outcome") | starts_with("MID_ARRAY_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "Raw_Outcome",
    values_to = "Response_Value"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Response_Value)) %>%
  mutate(
    # Extract outcome label inside brackets [Generic Outcome A] or keep raw header name
    Outcome = if_else(
      str_detect(Raw_Outcome, "\\[.*\\]"),
      str_extract(Raw_Outcome, "(?<=\\[).+?(?=\\])"),
      Raw_Outcome
    ),
    # Map code (A1-A6) if present, otherwise use response string as-is
    Threshold = recode(Response_Value, !!!code_to_text, .default = Response_Value),
    Threshold = factor(Threshold, levels = threshold_levels)
  )

# Compute counts and percentages
df_summary <- df_processed %>%
  group_by(Outcome, Threshold) %>%
  summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
  mutate(Percentage = round((Count / sum(Count)) * 100, 1)) %>%
  ungroup()


```

## Summary Table of Survey Responses

```{r summary-table}
library(gt)

df_summary %>%
  gt(groupname_col = "Outcome") %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Summary Table of Survey Responses**"),
    subtitle = "Distribution of thresholds by clinical outcome"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    Threshold = "Response Option / Threshold Level",
    Count = "Count (n)",
    Percentage = "Percentage (%)"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = Percentage,
    decimals = 1,
    pattern = "{x}%"
  ) %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "left",
    columns = Threshold
  ) %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "right",
    columns = c(Count, Percentage)
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.width = pct(100),
    heading.title.font.size = px(16),
    column_labels.font.weight = "bold",
    row_group.font.weight = "bold",
    row_group.background.color = "#f7f9fa",
    table.border.top.color = "black",
    table.border.bottom.color = "black"
  )
```

## Distribution of Threshold Preferences

```{r stacked-bar-chart, fig.width=10, fig.height=5.5}
mycol <- c(
  "All / almost all (>90%) - Unimportant" = "#d62728", # Dark Red
  "Most (75-90%) - Unimportant"           = "#ff7f0e", # Orange
  "Majority (51-74%) - Unimportant"       = "#ffbb78", # Light Orange
  "Majority (51-74%) - Important"         = "#c5b0d5", # Soft Purple
  "Most (75-90%) - Important"             = "#aec7e8", # Light Blue
  "All / almost all (>90%) - Important"   = "#1f77b4"  # Dark Blue
)

# Re-order levels in reverse so legend/stack order builds intuitively
ordered_thresholds <- rev(levels(df_summary$Threshold))

df_summary %>%
  filter(Count > 0) %>%
  mutate(Threshold = factor(Threshold, levels = ordered_thresholds)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Outcome, y = Count, fill = Threshold)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(Count, "\n(", sprintf("%.1f%%", Percentage), ")")),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = mycol) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    y = "Number of Respondents",
    x = NULL,
    title = "Minimal Important Difference Threshold Preferences",
    caption = "Source: WHO"
  ) +
theme_bw() +
theme(
  text = element_text(family = "sans", face = "plain", colour = "black"),
  legend.position = "bottom",
  legend.title = element_blank(),
  panel.border = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
  axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, vjust = 0.3, margin = margin(5, 0, 0, 0)),
  axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
  legend.text = element_text(size = rel(0.9)),
  plot.background = element_rect(colour = NA, fill = "white"),
  strip.background = element_rect(colour = "white", fill = "white"),
  plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
  axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black", hjust = 0.5)
) +
guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 6, byrow = TRUE))
```
